'''Magma shunts''' were devices used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] to divert [[Magma/Legends|lava]] flows away from [[City/Legends|cities]] and toward the planet's surface. Because of the shunts, the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] were not in danger of being killed by lava, despite living on a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] world.<ref name="Strongholds" />
